skill.displayName: AI Image Combiner – Merge Two Photos into One Online for Free – API-powered
skill.summary: AI image combiner — naturally merge two photos into a single cohesive image

latestVersion.changelog:
ai-image-combiner-openapi-skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the AI image combiner skill.
- Seamlessly merges two photos into a single cohesive image using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Requires HTTPS and WESHOP_API_KEY for authentication.
- Includes endpoints for image upload, running merges, and polling run status.
- Supports optional custom merge descriptions and batch image generation (1-16 images per request).
